local_changes: Queries `DpdHeadword` with `joinedload(DpdHeadword.ta)` instead of `joinedload(DpdHeadword.sbs/ru)`.
Iterates `ta_meaning`, splits on `";"`, and indexes each sub-meaning as a lookup key.
No root processing (Tamil has no root meanings) — headwords only.
No POS abbreviation replacement (no Tamil abbreviation map exists).
Stores `(lemma_clean, pos, ta_meaning)` tuples in `Lookup.tpd`.
watch_for: If upstream `epd_to_lookup.py` changes its loop or data structure, mirror here.
`db/tpd/__init__.py` is an empty package init; no sync concern.
